episodeTitle.en: A framework for PM skill development | Vikrama Dhiman (Gojek)
episodeTitle.zh: 产品经理技能发展框架 | 维克拉马·迪曼（Go-Jek）

guestBioOfficial.en: Vikrama Dhiman heads all things product at Gojek, including product management, design, program management, and research, across Indonesia, Singapore and India. He has over 16 years of experience building internet products, consults with Fortune 500 companies, and is among the most well-known and respected product leaders in all of Asia. In our conversation, we discuss: • The most common traits among successful product managers
guestBioOfficial.zh: 维克拉马·迪曼负责Go-Jek在印度尼西亚、新加坡和印度的所有产品相关事务，包括产品管理、设计、项目管理和研究。他拥有超过16年的互联网产品开发经验，为《财富》500强公司提供咨询服务，是亚洲最知名、最受尊敬的产品领袖之一。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：• 成功产品经理最常见的特质

title.en: A framework for PM skill development | Vikrama Dhiman (Gojek)
title.zh: 产品经理技能发展框架 | 维克拉马·迪曼（Go-Jek）

summary.en: Vikrama shares a practical framework for PM skill development, how to break into product management, and the common ways PMs shoot themselves in the foot. He discusses operating across diverse Asian markets, balancing breadth and depth as a product leader, and lessons from scaling Gojek's super-app. The episode is a grounded, mentorship-style guide especially useful for product managers in fast-growing markets.
summary.zh: Vikrama 分享了一套务实的“产品经理技能发展”框架、如何进入产品管理领域，以及产品经理常犯的自我挫败式错误。他讨论了横跨多元亚洲市场的运营、作为产品领导者如何平衡广度与深度，以及规模化 Gojek 超级应用中的经验。本期是一份扎根的、导师风格的指南，对快速增长市场中的产品经理尤其有用。
